company.shortDescription: The only piece of software a coffee shop needs to operate.
company.description: Dripos is a software platform that provides POS, employee scheduling, payroll, and everything in between for coffee shops.

productsAndServices.description: An all-in-one cloud-based platform for coffee shops that combines point of sale, online ordering, menu management, payments, customer loyalty, inventory, analytics, and multi-location operations.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Core Operating Platform

productsAndServices.description: Financial tools for coffee shops covering payroll, bookkeeping, accounting, tax filing support, capital access, payouts, and business reporting within the Dripos platform.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Financial Management

productsAndServices.description: Employee management software for hiring, onboarding, scheduling, time tracking, communications, checklists, performance reporting, and payroll for coffee shop teams.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Team Management

productsAndServices.description: Customer engagement software for coffee shops that supports campaigns, loyalty programs, promotions, coupons, gift cards, fundraisers, and customer email or text messaging.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Marketing Tools

productsAndServices.description: Operational software for coffee shops that manages inventory, supply chain activity, invoicing, checklists, cost tracking, and connected sales and labor data.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Operations Management

productsAndServices.description: Point-of-sale and shop equipment for coffee businesses, including tablets, stands, kiosks, printers, cash drawers, kitchen display systems, barcode scanners, and card readers.
productsAndServices.name: Dripos Hardware

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 63.24% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,898,713 to $57,039,883, a 30.04x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
